thread:
Elena (CEO): Morning team — quick quarter-check and a compact set of asks. TL;DR: stabilize private GA, cap Dedicated cost growth, finalize data-retention defaults, and a small-model launch next week. Please read and respond with owners/ETA.

Elena (CEO): Priorities (short):
- Stabilize Private GA: hit 99.95% availability in us-east across all customers (current: 99.82%).
- Growth vs cost: cap Dedicated GPU cost growth to +8% q/q; identify immediate unit-economy wins.
- Policy: default data-retention = 30d for hosted logs + clear opt-in for longer retention. Legal + Security to draft clause.
- Launch cadence: ship quantized model-family canary next Wed; prod rollout guarded by eval gate.

Elena (CEO): Asks (owners/ETA):
- @Samir (VP Eng): stabilization plan and canary guardrails by Tue EOD. Include rolling restart playbook and SLO rollback criteria.
- @Priya (CPO): pause noncritical UI/console features this sprint; align product roadmap to focus on private GA quality by Fri.
- @Marta (Head Finance): model cost impact + 90-day burn reserve proposal by Thu.
- @Tomas (SRE): runbook updates + run a golden-canary test tomorrow morning at 09:00 PT.
- Legal/Security (cc): draft short customer-facing note for retention policy before Monday.

Elena (CEO): Key metrics snapshot (last 7d): p50 latency hosted gen = 120ms, p95 = 720ms; private GA error-rate = 0.18% (target <0.05%); incidents affecting user-visible latency = 3; token cost / 1M = $14.10 (we need to hit $13.20).

Samir (VP Eng): Ack — plan incoming. Immediate steps: bump autoscaler cooldown, reduce max-batch size for 8x GPUs on private clusters, and stage a rolling restart with drain windows. I'll attach a minimal patch to infra tonight. Canary guardrails: abort on >5% error delta or >50ms p50 regression.

Priya (CPO): Got it. I'm deprioritizing noncritical console UX for this sprint and will scope a lightweight eval harness for the quant models (quality vs token-savings). Propose A/B on 5% of traffic during canary.

Marta (Head Finance): Noted. I'll model the Dedicated cap and propose a $500k reserve for Q next week. If Samir's plan reduces p95, we should see lower incident-driven overtime.

Tomas (SRE): Running golden-canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. Question: does the retention default change need to be opt-out for existing customers? That affects the rollout message.

Elena (CEO): Not for today — default change will be opt-in for existing customers; new signups get 30d default. Legal to confirm wording.

DeployBot: Scheduled deploy: infra/rolling-restart v1.4 -> staging at 3865012360. See runbook: https://internal.runbook/redwood/rolling-restart

Samir (VP Eng): tiny follow-up — we'll need a short maintenance window note for customers if we hit the >5% abort. Tomas, can you draft the blurb?

Tomas (SRE): Yep, I'll post a customer-facing blurb and internal incident escalation template after the canary run.

Elena (CEO): Cool. Let's treat this as the exec brief for the week — 15-minute sync tomorrow 10:30 PT if needed. Thanks. :white_check_mark:

Priya (CPO): :thumbsup:

Marta (Head Finance): Copy — will share numbers by Thu.

Samir (VP Eng): Will drop the stabilization PR tonight.

Elena (CEO): Appreciate the quick turnaround — focus on measurable regressions and clear rollback gates.
